name: 411.ca

search.notes: 411.ca person profiles live at /person/profile/<id>. On 2026-10-21 the person search tab on 411.ca sent users to Canada411, so check old 411.ca profiles through a search engine.

steps: Search for the person's 411.ca profile and copy its URL.
Email the 411.ca Privacy Officer at privacy@411.ca and ask for the listing to be removed, giving the profile URL, the name and the phone number shown.
Keep a copy of the email and the date sent.
If there is no answer, follow up by post to 411.ca Privacy Officer, 1500 Don Mills Rd, Suite 600, Toronto, ON M3B 3K4.
optout.notes: The privacy policy names the Privacy Officer for access, correction and account deletion. It does not describe removal of directory listings, so this route is a best guess based on that contact.

verification_note: 411.ca privacy policy loaded with HTTP 200 on 2026-10-21, but it describes account deletion, not directory listing removal. No listing removal page was found. 411.ca/faq and 411.ca/help returned 404.
